name: Caviar Blini
effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 160–228 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: Blini served with caviar. Each golden pancake is topped with a dollop of Smetana and a spoonful of savory caviar. Soft and lightly creamy, the blini provide the perfect contrast to the caviar's rich, briny flavor.

suspicious.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: Blini served with caviar. An unsteady hand has scattered most of the caviar everywhere, and what little roe manages to stay on the blini is neither plump nor fresh. One bite unleashes a stubborn fishy taste that lingers on the palate like some curse dredged up from the deep sea...

delicious.description: Blini topped with glossy black caviar. Each plump bead gleams like a tiny black pearl with a subtle sheen. With a gentle bite, the pillowy blini give way to the fresh, briny pop of the roe, the two melting together in perfect harmony. It is as though the finest bounty hidden beneath the frozen seas has been gathered into a single bite.
